notes.title: Important Development Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and sorry for taking so long to update you, I know it's been a long time since I've made a post regarding the game and the status of the latest updates so I'm making this announcement to fill you in on what's been happening.   

The first issue I would like to discuss is the delays in development and projected updates.  Due to unforeseen events that have taken place over the last couple of months development has come to a temporary hold. I know a lot of you were looking forward to the updates such as melee weapons new UI and Bug fixes for multiplayer parties and fine-tuning the gameplay mechanics however at this time I cannot continue development at the pace I've started the project with. This does not mean the game is cancelled or the development has stopped forever. What it does mean is that until I am able to take care of some pressing issues in my personal life I will not be able to provide updates and move the game forward at this time.  I know this is very disappointing to a lot of you in the community, we started this project with great momentum and a strong base community and I hope that we can build on that in the future. Now with all that said I will not be able to give you a concrete timeline as to when development will be able to resume due to the current situation we are all going through globally. I'm hoping to be able to return to development within 3 to 6 months.

Next, I would like to discuss the plans I have for the game moving forward. I will be rolling the game back to an earlier build, I have not decided on which build version I'll be rolling back to you at this time. I'm rolling a game back to an earlier version so that players have a more optimized version of the game to enjoy while development is on hold. There will be an announcement posted once the game has been rolled back to the appropriate version. 

I'm also considering switching the game over to free to play during the early access stage development. The game will remain free to play until it is ready for full release. Making the game free to play is my way of trying to give back to those who supported the development by purchasing the game, streaming the game on Twitch, participating in the community, and providing important feedback. My Hope Is that you'll be able to share all the progress we have made on the game so far with your friends and show them the game that you helped to build.

Now because the game will be (possibly)  going free-to-play this does not mean I will be adding in any microtransactions during the Early Access development. I will not rule out the possibility of microtransactions in the full release version once development is completed. 

I'd like to get feedback from the community on the decision to make the game free to play before making a final decision. Ultimately I will be making the final decision but it is important hear from people who have invested time and money into the game.

I'd like to thank everyone for all of their effort on the project and for taking the time play my game and give it a chance. I will continue to work hard and develop the game so I can give you an awesome zombie slaying experience once I am able too. I really wish I had the ability to see these unfortunate events coming but I did not so I will continue planning for the future and the completion of blood horde, it just won't be in the timeline that I had projected originally.



Thank you for understanding and I hope you all stay safe,

Tye

notes.title: Multiplayer Optimizations & UI
notes.notes:
In this update for bloody horde, I've added a new main menu and Lobby as part of the user interface overhaul. There's still much more to be done to the user interface which will be rolled out over the next few weeks. Things like settings menus Bobby's and end game screens will be getting an update.

 The next big part of the update is the line tracing for the weapons system has been updated and further optimized for multiplayer. During the testing phase for this update,  I found that the performance for multiplayer games has greatly improved. In a 3 player game at wave 20, there were no lag or latency issues found. I will continue taking user feedback and testing the client in order to fully optimize the gameplay and provide a seamless experience.   All of the weapons should handle exactly how they did before but if you find any issues please report them either in the Discord or on the community hub,  this helps me improve the quality of the gameplay for everyone.

 Again I'd like to give a big shout-out to everybody who is helping me test the game, everyone who bought the game, and everyone who is following the development!  With your feedback and comments, I've been able to get a better feel for what players want in a game like this. The rest of the updates mentioned in previous posts are still on track and you should continue to see 1-2 updates per month.
 
 I'm also considering launching a demo version of the game with limited content and no multiplayer capabilities to itch.io  so that more people can play the game and decide whether or not they want to be a part of the development.  However, before I follow through with this I would like to hear back from the community and the people who have bought the game so far.  I would love to provide a demo for people to try the game but I do not want to upset anyone who has previously purchased the game.  Therefore I will be collecting feedback over the next week regarding this issue and if the player base is in support of it then I will follow through with launching a demo. 

 Thank you all for taking the time to read this post and thank you very much for helping fuel the development!  You guys are awesome, stay safe!

** If you experience a crash attempting to load in a map, please adjust your frame rate settings and possibly your resolution.  There seems to be a one time bug that some players are experiencing.  Most players have reported this happening on map 2.

notes.title: Weapon Sounds, Drops, Sprint Speed.
notes.notes:
Over the past few weeks, I've been working on changing the gun sounds with new, more realistic gunfire sounds. Each weapon received a new sound asset with the exception of the plasma launcher, boom tube, and plasma blaster.  I've also made some adjustments to the new UI sounds.  Weapon sounds were one of the main complaints I remember reading in the comments during live streams so I made it the top priority for the last few weeks to get them changed.  I will continue to make changes like this in the future based on community feedback.



 I've also adjusted the zombie boss by lowering the base health by 1000. 

 Blocking volumes were added to the antenna towers on the roof of map 1.

 Sprint speed has been increased by 20.

 The mower's rate of fire has been dropped slightly and the damage has been increased.

 

There was a previous update also added to steam a few weeks ago I posted the details in Discord but forgot to share them here. Here are the changes from that patch:

 Fixed zombie tracking on map 2.

 Adjusted spawners on map 2.

 Adjusted drops for later rounds.

 Pacer accuracy correction.



For the next update I will be doing an overhaul of the line trace for the firing system so that it is optimized for multiplayer.  I will also be overhauling a lot of the replicated events as well as updating the zombie AI.  This update will also fix the spawning issue for blood decals.  Overall this next update will be a large one and should flush out any final problems with network latency on multiplayer  and fix a few bugs in the base game play.



Thank you everyone for your patience and your commitment to sending me bug reports we've been able to track down a lot of issues and I feel like in the month that the game has been out we have made a good amount of progress. Given the scope of the next few updates that are planned out, you should expect to see one or two updates a month until the end of February. My goal is to have melee hand grenades added in by the end of February as well as a massive update to the UI.

notes.title: Lights! Sonds! Frames!
notes.notes:
Thanks to community feedback I have added a few features that you guys ( and gals ) should enjoy!

Power Up drops now change color 10 seconds before despawning.

Wall buy weapons now change color when a player is in the interaction range.

Weapon box changes colors when active and resets color when finished.

New Sounds FX for drops and purchases.

Traps have an indicator light for their cool downs.

To help combat multiplayer sync issues and general performance issues, the framerate is locked to 60 FPS for all players and the setting has been removed from the settings menue.

notes.title: Spooky Season Update!
notes.notes:
This week I have made some changes to the enemy AI so they are more aggressive! The Ai has a larger attack range and improved collision, as well as a new goal location system for targeting players which makes the pathfinding more organic. The zombies also have slightly increased movement speed in lower waves.

There is now a Controls Menu off of the Main Menu where players can see the keybindings for the keyboard and controller. ( Currently, remapping is not available )

Animation fix for player characters: Running with rifle animation now loops perfectly without a jump frame between loops. Stepping audio resynced to animation.

Reduced RPCs: Changes to code in player characters and Zombie characters which should help with network performance. 

Player Aim / Crouch Speed: Reduced from 275 to 265

Character Flashlight: Changes made to the flashlight to help with general performance.

Doors on Map1 (factory): Replaced costly light setup with a performance-friendly setup.

Textures: Reduced select texture sizes to improve general performance. 

Free Look Removed: Removed Code for a free look feature that was not meant to be in the production version. Free Look was causing issues when users would Alt+Tab to another window while playing. 

Don't forget to join the discord to report bugs, provide feedback, and learn more about the project!

Discord:  https://discord.gg/Pp35FDU

Thank you, everyone, for all of the support, and thank you to all the amazing streamers on twitch for hyping up the game and spreading the word about Bloody Horde! Without your help, the game would not be at its current level of success! 

Cheers! Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Enemy Tracking Patch
notes.notes:
There was a problem with Zombies not going up to the roof on Map 1 caused by the last patch which has now been fixed. 

Happy Hunting!

Report Bugs: https://discord.gg/Pp35FDU

notes.title: Overlays, Boss Health and More!
notes.notes:
In this update, I have patched some bugs and addressed issues brought to my attention by the awesome Bloody Horde community! I Have also added some of the planned content I was preparing such as a new damage overlay and different animations.

First let me start off by saying thank to the amazing community for providing me with all of your great feedback and bug reports! By reporting issues and providing suggestions and feedback, you are making my development experience so much more efficient, saving me time and allowing me to focus on important issues :)

The Features added are as followed;
New Chase Animation Variation for the Zombies.
New Attack Animation for all Zombies including the boss. ( Montage will replace single anims later)
Base Zombie Boss health is now set to 1100 + wave multiplier  (was 1500)
Lower waves have slight increase in zombie movement (wave 1 & 2)

Bugs addressed;
Base Zombie animation glitch
Box Jumping (Map 2 & 3)
Tweaks to pathfinding for ai
Spawn Issues on Map 1 (addressed but may still require more work)
Removed Nav modifier component from zombies ( May help with latency issues)

Bugs Under Investigation;
Latency Issues with 4 Player games (Hoping the nav component removal will reduce network cost)
Delay shooting after reload

Much more to come! I am trying to rollout updates in a timely manner but also working to provide quality updates with a good amount of content and/or bug fixes.

Thank you everyone for your continued efforts and support!

Welcome to all the new players :) I hope to see you all in the Official Discord: https://discord.gg/nNAatjW

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone here is a quick update on today's patch. 

There was a lighting issue causing reflections to not render properly on some characters ( Dark almost black helmet with no reflection ) this has been fixed as well as the ramps in Arena 1. The Stairs have invisible ramps to make the navigation easier for the ai however they were set to visible which is a big oversight on my part. 

I apologize for leaving those visible as they take away from the environment and the experience. I regret not catching this sooner as it has been that way for 3 days and that is not acceptable. In the future, I will be sure to triple-check before setting any future builds to public. 

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Launch Update!
notes.notes:
Here it is the Launch Update! In this update, You will find new modles for the wall buy weapons and the random weapon box! New hologram materieal for the lobby character place holder and more path varaition for the enemies. The rest of this update consists of performance improvement and network improvments for multiplayer. Updated the spectator camera to have less jitter. More updates to come so stay tuneded!

In the next update, I plan to update the menues and player HUD as well as fix any bugs found by the player community.

We encourage all players to report bugs whenever possible on the discussion borad or in the discord as it help bring a higher quality gaming experience to everyone!

Welcome to all of the new players :)

notes.title: Multiplayer and Optimization Update!
notes.notes:
In this week's update, I reworked the zombie health system and adjusted the weapon damage accordingly. I Also patched some replication issues that were causing players and zombies to zip around the map on higher waves in Multiplayer. The "back" button for the server browser was not appearing at some desktop resolutions, this has been fixed, Traps now to more damage to zombies in higher waves.

In the next update, I hope to further optimize the multiplayer game mode and work on any bugs that get reported.

You can report any bugs to the discord (still under construction) or Email t.cassidy@ttcmedia.ca. You can also report bugs on the community discussion board.

Stay safe and have fun everyone!
